caption: Lightning flashes over a vineyard at night, and the rows of vines are lit for an instant before the dark returns.

sa.check: A vineyard at night with rows of vines.
The rows of vines are lit for an instant.
The order is dark, flash, dark.

pc.expect: The flash is brief: the vineyard brightens and returns to dark; flashes may repeat but each ends.
pc.fail: The vineyard stays lit for the rest of the clip after the flash; or brightens steadily; or the flash fades in slowly like a dimmer; or the sky turns to daylight.

pc.expect: The flash lights the whole scene at once: the rows, the ground between them and the cloud undersides brighten together during the flash, from the sky's direction.
pc.fail: The sky flashes while the vines stay as dark as before; or the vines light up while the sky stays dark; or the light sweeps across the rows one after another; or the rows are lit from below.

pc.expect: The rows, posts and any buildings are the same across dark and lit frames.
pc.fail: Rows or posts appear or vanish between dark and lit frames; or a building appears; or the rows change direction; or the vines change shape.

pc.expect: The vines and posts stay still through the flash; leaves stir only in the wind.
pc.fail: The vines shake sharply at the flash with nothing else stirring; or posts move; or the ground shifts.

pc.expect: The vines and posts keep their shapes and stay rooted; nothing passes through anything; any bolt seen ends in the air or at the ground.
pc.fail: A row merges into a wall; or a bolt passes through a vine and lights it like a lamp; or a post morphs into another object; or the ground turns into water.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The foliage colour, the soil and the sky are consistent before and after the flash.
pc.fail: The foliage changes colour permanently; or the soil changes colour; or the sky turns to daylight after the flash.
